story: I wrote a program that emails me when one of my friends orders Domino's
text: That seems a rather big privacy issue on Domino's part. I wonder if it also opens the doors to some kind of social engineering attack, with someone pretending to be Domino's asking for money over the phone. As an aside I thought this is rather cool - Pizza Party a CLI for Domino's [VIDEO] (One day I'd like to be able to afford to cron job something like that ;)
